newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Engine trouble strands boatpeople in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Engine trouble strands boatpeople in Indonesia.

text.p: Forty-four ethnic Vietnamese on their way to Australia were stranded off the East Java coastal town of Gresik this week when their boat broke down with engine trouble, an Indonesian port official said on Wednesday.
A spokesman for the Gresik port authority, Subianto, said the boatpeople arrived on Sembilangan island on Monday after leaving China on March 10.
The port spokesman said it was still unclear whey they left from China, adding indonesian authorities had yet to find out.
"The wooden ship is still there and all the people on the boat are in good health. They are stranded because their boat developed engine trouble," he told Reuters.
"It is still unclear when they will be able to leave," he said, adding both authorities and locals had given them food.
The official Antara news agency said on Wednesday the boatpeople had told authorities they were travelling to Australia.
Antara quoted spokesman for the Gresik port authorities as saying the group comprised 31 men and 13 women, adding that seven of them are between one and six years old.
It said the Surabaya marine patrol found the Vietnamese stranded aboard the boat and escorted them to the Gresik port at 8 p.m. (1300 GMT) on Monday.
The report said the boat had earlier been stranded in the waters off Pontianak, capital of West Kalimantan, 13 days after setting sail from China.
